bullets.text: Technical lead of the in-house development team again, after the earlier 2022 to 2025 period; responsible for architecture, technical direction and the team's way of working.
Driving the ongoing modernisation of the B2B platform and the Bike Labyrinth Home app, with a focus on performance, maintainability and a scalable frontend architecture.
Led a team of developers building and maintaining the B2B software, the Bike Labyrinth Home app and the company website, combining people leadership with hands-on full-stack work.
Ported the existing B2B software to React Native and TypeScript.
Owned the release process end to end: build configuration, App Store Connect and Google Play Console releases, in-app purchases via RevenueCat, and production monitoring.
Introduced code review, testing and agile practices; coached juniors and mediated technical disagreements toward decisions the whole team could stand behind.
Made explicit build-versus-adopt calls on libraries and services, weighing long-term maintainability against delivery speed.
(Utrecht University / Vrije Universiteit Brussel, 2025 to present): continued development and maintenance of the research platform's code base. Next.js, React, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
(2025): designed and built the website and webshop for a high-end Amsterdam florist. Framer, Shopify.
Web and app development for a range of clients, working directly with founders and designers to turn business goals into shippable software.
Operational coordination on site during festivals and events, keeping teams and planning aligned while decisions have to be made in the moment.
Responsible for the preparation and supply of the bars at festivals including Orbit, Smeerboel and Hullabaloo.

Ran the commercial operation of a bar and led its staff at festivals including Lowlands, Down The Rabbit Hole, 538 Koningsdag and Soenda, including briefing and giving direct feedback under real time pressure.
Owned the education and onboarding programme for new developers and interns; mentored and coached them through their first projects.
Built React frontends for large media and healthcare clients: a new UI for the NPO Start CMS, a form management system for Nedap Healthcare, and a voice assistant prototype for the NPO Start app.
Worked in cross-functional teams with designers and product owners, translating designs and requirements into maintainable component architectures.
Mentored interns and reviewed their work alongside my own delivery.
